name: Synn
message: 「If I'm going to make up with Macaron... first, what should I even say to start talking to her...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Forget that, it's lunchtime, lunchtime. Hurry up or lunch break's gonna end」

name: Synn
message: 「Today, just like every other day, a curry bento...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Food and drink are prohibited in the library」

name: Melilot
message: 「Isn't it you who has something on your mind?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's rare for you to come here without any business, Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「I thought you might have something troubling you」

name: Melilot
message: 「Besides, it's written all over your face that I hit the mark」

name: Synn
message: 「Actually, I'm having a bit of trouble with a personal relationship...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see. It is just as Helena said.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Half of it was my own intuition, while the other half was at Helena's instigation.」

name: Melilot
message: 「"Attentive care for the students is also a chairwoman's duty..."」

name: Melilot
message: 「In all likelihood, she heard from Ria that Sakura-kun was acting strangely.」
Even while I'm like this, I'm making the people around me worry...
I really need to pull myself together.

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, you were having trouble with interpersonal relationships, correct?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Have you found a girl you like?」

name: Synn
message: 「No... It's not that I dislike her.」

name: Synn
message: 「At first, we got along right away...」

name: Synn
message: 「Truth is, I want to get even closer to her...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...So you already understand both your own feelings and what you wish to do.」

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, you need only convey them.」
What I was agonizing over wasn't what I should do.
I just wanted a push to actually go through with it...

name: Melilot
message: 「...It seems there's no longer any need for me to counsel you further.」

name: Synn
message: 「Not at all, you were a huge help.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Have you found the courage to take action?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Don't mention it. Guiding troubled students is part of my job, after all.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I wonder which one of them is truly worthy...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nah, not really. You've got club activities, right, Nanaka?」

name: Synn
message: 「Try not to push yourself so hard you get a stomachache.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn acting weird is nothing new, anyway...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Are you looking for the squirt or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「Before that, there's something I want to look into」

name: Synn
message: 「What happened between the humans and the Demons who were at the venue on the day of KiraFes」

name: Synn
message: 「I want to follow up on the parts I couldn't finish patrolling that day」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, I think you should just do whatever you want, Demon Lord」

name: Tame-san
message: 「I was at the shop the whole time that day too, but...」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Yeah, sorry I couldn't be of any help」

name: Tame-san
message: 「By the way, did Macaron-chan like that thing?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Is that so, is that so? Well, that's great」

name: Tame-san
message: 「I don't really get what's going on between you two, but you take care of each other, alright?」
I can't exactly tell him I haven't seen her since then...

name: Synn
message: 「No clues from Shina-oba, Tame-san, or Kim-san's place either, huh」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord, are you seriously planning to go around the whole shopping district by yourself?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I can't exactly ask humans to do it, can I?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't you think you're getting a little too worked up over this?」
I have to be the one to talk to Macaron.
No. Because I want to handle this myself...

name: Synn
message: 「I'll keep at it a little longer」

name: Synn
message: 「There were people who saw a creature that looked like a Demon, though nobody saw the commotion itself...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, the venue was pretty huge, after all」
Is there anything else I can do...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahaha... Well, I just happened to hear something interesting」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, really! I was at the shop Sacchin recommended until just a bit ago!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And apparently, the shopkeeper saw a Demon during Kirafes!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It seemed like they wanted the cakes out front」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When the shopkeeper talked to them wondering if they had money, they suddenly went and ate the cake」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's a Demon who just came to the Human World, they wouldn't know anything about money...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Probably. Maybe they thought they could just eat whatever they wanted」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And then when the shopkeeper scolded them, they ran off, apparently」

name: Synn
message: 「If you eat something you thought you were allowed to eat and get yelled at for it, that'd make you feel sad」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The shopkeeper said they might've acted a little childish, though」
Neither of them meant any harm, after all.
If they just understood each other properly, it's really just a trivial misunderstanding.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? Ah, nah, something like this is no big deal!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You know, Nana-chan kept going on and on about how Synn-kun was acting weird~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And then she even went around questioning the shopkeeper~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? Oh, it's fine, it's fine, I don't sweat the small stuff!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I could tell right away that you were worried about Mako-chan, Synn」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And honestly, I can't just leave Mako-chan alone either」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, when you're down in the dumps, Synn, it throws off my groove too!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Childhood friends for the win~ Mutual love, huh~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, Synn! We'll help out too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, we already checked around here」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's fine! I made sure to ask for backup」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san begged me so desperately that I had no choice but to help out, okay!」

name: Shio
message: 「Now then, I was asking around over by the park, and...」

name: Shio
message: 「Yes. I met some children who said they encountered a creature resembling a monster on the day in question」

name: Shio
message: 「According to them, the monster seemed to take an interest in the balloons the children were holding」

name: Synn
message: 「I bet it was planning to play with them」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Or maybe it thought they were one of its own」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, you can probably guess what happened next」

name: Misa
message: 「Something caused a balloon to pop, and the startled kid started making a fuss...」

name: Misa
message: 「Apparently, a parent nearby chased the Demon away, and it fled」

name: Shio
message: 「It seems the children were not particularly frightened of the monster」

name: Misa
message: 「If anything, they said the parent was scarier when they were chasing the Demon away」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Parents these days are way too overprotective. They ought to take a page out of Synn's family's book」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, what just happened was just a misunderstanding we could work out if we talked it through...」
They simply didn't know anything about each other.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you for your hard work, Jeeves」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry. Feels like I'm putting you through a lot of trouble...」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't worry about it, don't worry about it. We're all here to help each other out when things get tough, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I made sure to look into everything that happened on the day of KiraFes!」

name: Ria
message: 「We went around asking various people connected to the academy about it, you see」

name: Ria
message: 「During KiraFes, certain facilities were off-limits, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「It seems a Demon wandered in there by mistake, got spotted, and was kicked out」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Expecting a Demon who doesn't understand the language to read warning signs seems rather pitiful, doesn't it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「After all, there are words that even we don't understand!」

name: Misa
message: 「Coming from you, Lolotte, that really carries some weight」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, given the situation, I guess it's hard to blame them for mistaking that as being rejected...」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, I think there's room for both sides to meet in the middle」

name: Ria
message: 「When you work so hard, Synn-kun, it makes us feel like we have to do something too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「After all, getting along is such a wonderful thing♪」

name: Misa
message: 「I'd feel bad for Macaron-san if things stayed like this, you know. Not that I care about Sakura-kun or anything!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now it's your turn to go nail it, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「I want you to hear me out」

name: Synn
message: 「I want to make up with you...... with all of you, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「We weren't even friends in the first place......」

name: Synn
message: 「Whether human or Demon, I believe we can get along」

name: Synn
message: 「Then listen properly to what I have to say」

name: Synn
message: 「...So, I think neither side meant any harm」

name: Synn
message: 「They were just strangers to each other and got startled」

name: Macaron
message: 「...You saw other people eating it, so you thought it was okay to eat, right」

name: Macaron
message: 「When you break someone else's things, you have to apologize」

name: Macaron
message: 「You can't go into unfamiliar places by yourselves. When that happens, you tell me」

name: Macaron
message: 「Okay, everyone, what do you say when you're sorry?」

name: Synn
message: 「No. I invited you guys too lightly as well. I'm sorry」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll go apologize to the cake shop and the kid who was holding the balloons」

name: Macaron
message: 「No. Because I'm these guys' guardian. That's my responsibility」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, I have a responsibility as the Student Council President who ran KiraFes」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like we'll be able to... get along again」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's not like I trust all humans yet, you know」

name: Macaron
message: 「We were even after KiraFes, and I get that you guys are good humans」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, that doesn't mean all humans are like you guys, right!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm not letting my guard down just yet!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why I want you to spend time with us and get to know humans」

name: Synn
message: 「Won't you judge for yourself whether you can get along with us, Macaron?」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Why would you go that far for me?」

name: Macaron
message: 「To humans, demons are supposed to be better off gone...」

name: Synn
message: 「Once we're friends, none of that matters」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, it wouldn't be any fun if you couldn't get along with your friends, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Making everyone's school life fun is my goal, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「If everyone's having fun and happy, then I'm happy too. It's all good things!」

name: Synn
message: 「This right here is a truly sparkling school life!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I think it suits a carefree big brother like you just fine」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi, I'd never compliment you, big brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, since I don't have much choice...」

name: Macaron
message: 「If that's what you're going for, big brother, I'll play along」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll be the judge of whether the Human World is a worthy place for Demons to migrate to!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!? Since when did it turn into that!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're the one who said it, big brother」

name: Macaron
message: 「What's with that hand. I'm not giving you anything」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, it's a handshake. As a sign we made up」
Macaron's hand roughly settles into mine.

name: Macaron
message: 「But... if you get in my way, I won't go easy on you」
A black shadow charges straight at us at breakneck speed!
I get crushed in the blink of an eye!

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihaha! Big brother, you're such a dooofus!」

name: Synn
message: 「E-Everyone, Macaron says she'll shake your hands!」

name: Macaron
message: 「W-Wha, w-wait a second, ah, wa, st--...」

name: Synn
message: 「That was a pretty good scream from you though, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're one to talk, big brother, you had such a stupid look on your face I thought I'd die laughing」

name: Macaron
message: 「Fufu... Geez, what are you laughing at?」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's nighttime, we're gonna bother the neighbors」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're the one who left those vegetables yesterday, right, big brother?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Um, well, I was thinking about making dinner now...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm saying if you've got the guts to eat it, I'll make a special exception and let you have some!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh! In that case, I'll gladly take you up on that」

name: Synn
message: 「Man, it's been ages since someone made dinner for me」

name: Macaron
message: 「I-If it tastes bad... don't blame me!」
